meta.name: performing-soap-web-service-security-testing
meta.description: Perform security testing of SOAP web services by analyzing WSDL definitions and testing for XML injection, XXE, WS-Security bypass, and SOAPAction spoofing.

copy.tagline: 测试 SOAP web 服务安全性，发现 XML 注入、XXE 等漏洞
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要系统化测试 SOAP web 服务的安全性
copy.tagline_en: Test SOAP web service security, find XML injection, XXE and more
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need systematic security testing of SOAP web services

howto.what: 装上此技能后, Claude 可以根据 WSDL 分析和测试 SOAP Web 服务的安全性, 包括 XML 注入、XXE、WS-Security 绕过和 SOAPAction 欺骗等漏洞。
howto.when: 当用户提供 SOAP 服务的 WSDL 或端点 URL, 并要求执行安全测试时触发。也适用于渗透测试、审计等场景。

say.text: 帮我扫描这个SOAP服务是否存在XXE漏洞。
say.note: Claude将读取WSDL并发送XXE测试载荷。

say.text: 测试这个SOAP接口的WS-Security是否可绕过。
say.note: Claude会尝试移除Security头或发送空令牌。
Claude会发送操作A的体与操作B的SOAPAction。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can analyze WSDL definitions and test SOAP web services for XML injection, XXE, WS-Security bypass, and SOAPAction spoofing vulnerabilities.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user provides a WSDL or endpoint URL for a SOAP service and requests security testing. Also used during penetration testing or security audits.

say_en.text: Scan this SOAP service for XXE vulnerabilities.
say_en.note: Claude parses WSDL and sends XXE payloads.

say_en.text: Test if WS-Security on this endpoint can be bypassed.
say_en.note: Claude strips Security header or sends empty token.

say_en.text: Check if SOAPAction spoofing is possible.
say_en.note: Claude sends body of operation A with action of B.
